lines: facet authenticators supports: resources.json image:quay.io/jetstack/cert-manager-controller: the certificates it issues are the services' TLS authenticators.
facet certificate-issuing implements: resources.json image:quay.io/jetstack/cert-manager-controller: issues and renews every TLS certificate at the site from the site's own CA.
facet cryptography implements: resources.json image:quay.io/jetstack/cert-manager-controller: generates and renews certificate keys.
facet network-traffic supports: resources.json image:quay.io/jetstack/cert-manager-cainjector: writes CA bundles so services can trust each other on the network.
facet pki-trust implements: resources.json image:quay.io/jetstack/cert-manager-cainjector: writes the CA bundles the Kubernetes API trusts.
facet software implements: components/cert-manager.json: cert-manager is software every site runs.

facet access-decisions implements: src/domain/gate/decide.ts and src/gate/host.ts: the gate decides every tool, route and model request against the signed organization policy before it runs.

facet accounts supports: src/staff and src/domain/credentials: staff invitations, role changes and removals (G14) are recorded on the person's device; the accounts themselves are kept by your organization's identity provider and the hub.

facet admin-separation supports: src/domain/gate/layers.ts and src/gate/organizationStore.ts: the organization layer of the policy is signed by your organization's administrators and cannot be changed from an ordinary session.
facet audit-records implements: src/gate/decisionLog.ts: every gate decision is written to the local decision log (44.1-01 maps AU-02 to its tests).
facet audit-store implements: src/gate/decisionLog.ts: the local decision logs rotate at 5 MiB, keep four files and grant no group or other access (44.1-02-TRIAGE AU-04, AU-09).
facet authenticators implements: src/domain/did and src/gate/wallet.ts: the person's per-install Ed25519 identity key and the credentials in the wallet are held and checked on the device.
facet boundary-traffic implements: src/domain/gate/routing.ts and src/domain/gate/endpoints.ts: requests leave the device only to endpoints the signed policy allows (the route check).

facet cryptography implements: src/domain/credentials (ecdsaJcs2019.ts, dataIntegrity.ts) and src/domain/did/didKey.ts: signatures on policies, credentials and records; the crypto inventory lists its algorithms.
facet development supports: components/extension.json: the extension is this repository's code, built by the release pipeline (resources.json npm:typescript, npm:esbuild).
facet device-identity implements: src/gate/deviceIdentityCommand.ts and src/domain/did/deviceWords.ts: one Ed25519 identity per person per install, shown as six words.
facet external-service supports: src/domain/gate/endpoints.ts: the extension reaches the model endpoints your organization configures (the model-endpoints component).
facet labels implements: src/domain/gate/labels.ts, labelAlgebra.ts and src/gate/chatLabel.ts: classification labels on content and chats, and routing by label (Phase 70, CLAS-01 to CLAS-08).

facet malicious-code-checks supports: src/security/scan.ts and src/security/osv.ts: the extension checks a project's lockfiles against known-vulnerable package versions; the release pipeline scans the VSIX's own code (resources.json action:github/codeql-action/analyze).
facet monitoring supports: src/gate/decisionLog.ts: the gate records refused and allowed actions that your organization's monitoring can collect (G11 tracks forwarding).
facet network-traffic implements: components/extension.json and src/domain/gate/endpoints.ts: the extension sends prompts and context to model endpoints over TLS.

facet organization-data implements: src/gate/bundleStore.ts, src/gate/organizationStore.ts and the staff project store under src/staff: your organization's policy, projects and logs are kept on the device.
facet our-code implements: components/extension.json: the locally installed VS Code extension is written in this repository (src/).

facet admin-separation supports: hub/src/enrol.ts: the operator's enrolment file is separate from members' sessions.
facet audit-records implements: hub/src/log/logger.ts and hub/src/log/redact.ts: the hub writes its own redacted log.
facet audit-store supports: hub/src/store/schema.ts: the hub keeps the signed append log of every project.
facet authenticators implements: hub/src/http/session.ts and hub/src/keys.ts: the hub checks members' signed session requests and holds its own signing key.
facet backup-restore implements: hub/src/checkpoints.ts and hub/src/stateDir.ts: the hub's state and signed checkpoints are backed up and restored (the local hub drill).
facet boundary-traffic supports: exchanges.json hub-sealed-bundles: sealed entries cross between hubs that are not connected.
facet cryptography implements: hub/src/keys.ts and hub/src/secrets.ts: the hub's signing key and the HMAC of enrolments.
facet development supports: components/hub.json: the hub is built in this repository (hub/) by the release pipeline.
facet device-identity implements: hub/src/join.ts and hub/src/enrol.ts: devices are admitted by their signed join requests.

facet monitoring supports: hub/src/health.ts and hub/src/live/events.ts: health and live events for your organization's monitoring.
facet network-traffic implements: hub/src/http/server.ts: the hub is a network service over TLS.
facet organization-data implements: hub/src/store: shared staff projects of your organization are stored at rest.
facet our-code implements: components/hub.json: the hub is written in this repository (hub/src).
facet outside-users supports: exchanges.json hub-sealed-bundles: another organization's hub may carry sealed entries.

facet access-decisions implements: components/workbench.json and workbench/extension/src/node/egress-contribution.ts: the workbench reuses the extension's gate and allows egress only to policy-listed servers.
facet accounts supports: workbench/extension/src/common/session-identity.ts: the session runs as the signed-in person; the account itself is Keycloak's.
facet admin-separation implements: workbench/extension/src/common/key-service.ts: signing needs the step-up role (sterling-workbench-stepup) that an ordinary session does not hold.
facet audit-records implements: workbench/extension/src/browser/session-activity-frontend-module.ts and the extension gate log inside the image record the session's own events.
facet authenticators supports: workbench/extension/src/common/secret-store.ts and key-service.ts: the person's secrets and keys sit at their own OpenBao path, never in the image.

facet boundary-traffic implements: workbench/extension/src/node/egress-contribution.ts and exchanges.json model-servers and open-vsx: the session reaches only policy-listed model servers and the site extension mirror.
facet cryptography implements: workbench/extension/src/common/key-service.ts: signing through OpenBao's transit keys; TLS to OpenBao and the model servers.
facet development supports: components/workbench.json: the Sterling workbench image is built in this repository (workbench/Dockerfile) by the release pipeline.
facet device-identity supports: workbench/extension/src/common/identity.ts: the session is bound to the person's identity rather than a device; the node identity is RKE2's.
facet external-service supports: exchanges.json model-servers: workbench sessions send prompts to the model servers your organization's signed policy lists.
facet host-hardening supports: workbench/Dockerfile: the image runs as a non-root user on UBI 9 minimal; the node kernel settings are RKE2's.
facet labels implements: workbench reuses the extension's label handling (src/domain/gate/labels.ts) inside the image; 48.1-19 states ac-16 on it.
facet malicious-code-checks supports: resources.json tool:grype: the Release workflow scans the workbench image SBOM for known vulnerabilities before publishing.
facet monitoring supports: workbench/extension/src/browser/session-activity-frontend-module.ts: the session reports activity that the site's monitoring and Theia Cloud read.
facet network-traffic implements: exchanges.json model-servers and open-vsx: the session sends and receives over the network, over TLS.
facet organization-data implements: workbench/extension/src/browser/sterling-work-areas-module.ts and site-storage volumes: each person's workspace holds your organization's files.
facet our-code implements: components/workbench.json: the workbench extension and image are written in this repository (workbench/).
facet pki-trust supports: workbench/extension/src/node/backend-service.ts: TLS to OpenBao and the model servers is checked against the site CA.
facet process-isolation supports: components/theia-cloud.json: each person gets their own workbench container, which Theia Cloud starts and RKE2 isolates.
facet re-authentication supports: workbench/extension/src/common/key-service.ts: signing checks acr and auth_time and sends the person to step up first.
facet sessions supports: workbench/extension/src/common/session-identity.ts and session-activity.ts: the session view, its activity tracker and its retry.
facet shared-resources supports: components/workbench.json: many people's workbench containers share the site nodes and storage that RKE2 and site-storage separate.
facet sign-in supports: workbench/extension/src/browser/session-identity-frontend-module.ts: the session admits only the person oauth2-proxy signed in.
